segments.name: Beauty
segments.description: Multi-brand beauty company offering inclusive, accessible, clean, vegan and cruelty free cosmetics and skin care products to consumers.
segments.evidence: e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. ("e.l.f. Beauty" and together with our subsidiaries, the "Company," or "we") is a multi-brand beauty company that offers inclusive, accessible, clean, vegan and cruelty free cosmetics and skin care products.

revenueModel.text: Retailers and direct e-commerce consumers pay the Company for cosmetics and skin care products delivered at a point in time.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is recognized when control of promised goods or services is transferred to a customer in an amount that reflects the consideration that the Company expects to receive in exchange for those goods or services.

changes.text: In May 2026 the Company transferred the Keys Soulcare brand to Alicia Keys, removing it from the brand portfolio.
changes.evidence: We transferred the Keys Soulcare brand to Alicia Keys in May 2026 and it is no longer part of our brand portfolio.
